newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pitches 97/98 deficit at 1.2 pct of GDP.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pitches 97/98 deficit at 1.2 pct of GDP.

text.p: Egypt's budget deficit for 1997/98 was forecast at 1.2 percent of gross domestic product, compared to 1.5 percent budgeted for the current 1996/97 financial year, official figures showed.
Parliament approved the figures on Wednesday. The financial year ends on June 30. GDP figures were not available.

Finance Minister Mohieddin el-Gharib said in remarks published last month the state had cut the budget deficit to about 1.0 percent of GDP from the 1.1 percent it had fallen to in the beginning of 1997.
